page_topic_one_liner: How search engines work — crawling, indexing, serving/ranking pipeline, Googlebot, inverted index, and Search Console diagnostics
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional search-engine mechanics education, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must show the three-stage Crawl → Index → Serve pipeline with crawler bot and index library — NOT an AI chat answering queries.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): horizontal three-stage pipeline — Crawling (spider bot on webpage with link arrows), Indexing (database/library shelves storing page cards), Serving (mini SERP results panel with blue links blur), connected by accent arrows
Secondary: Googlebot-style crawler discovering URLs via sitemap XML tile + backlink arrow + internal link chain on simplified site map
Tertiary: inverted index visualization — keyword column mapping to stacked page document icons (blurred keywords)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is crawl/index/rank SEO not GEO)
Generic magnifying glass alone without pipeline stages
Real Google logo or Googlebot trademark
Affiliate dashboard unrelated to search infrastructure
